description: Start an AI Opportunity Assessment: a mini assessment, a discovery-call guide, or a full assessment from interview notes. Routes each request to the matching AOA tool.

input.description: Assessment request with selected route, current source evidence and conversation context when available.

name: aoa_ai_opportunity_assessment

action.description: out_of_scope for external actions or fabrication requests. prepare_report hands the request to next_tool in the same turn (the mini tool runs its own interview). ask_question for the welcome menu or one missing item.

choices.description: Options for this question, in order; [] when the question is free text or no question is asked. Host: show them as selectable cards or buttons when the app supports choice UI, otherwise as a numbered list under message. Always keep the last option, other. When the user picks other or types instead, call this tool again with their own words.

next_tool.description: mini_report -> run_aoa_mini_assessment; discovery_guide -> create_aoa_discovery_guide; full_report -> run_aoa_full_assessment; knowledge_base -> run_aoa_knowledge_base_assessment; none for ask_question and out_of_scope.

title: AOA AI Opportunity Assessment
